# Grand Touch Auto — PPF & Protection Studio, Dubai

> Grand Touch Auto is a premium paint protection film (PPF), tinting and detailing studio in Dubai Investment Park 2 (DIP 2), Dubai, UAE. Its flagship product is the Grand Touch Protection Program: three PPF packages with published prices and a written, installer-backed lifetime warranty (film AND labour) — the GT Owner's Warranty. WhatsApp +971 56 719 1045.

## The Grand Touch Protection Program (prices in AED, +VAT, full body, same price for every vehicle)

- GT Essential — 7,900: GT 5-Year Warranty (film + workmanship), self-healing gloss TPU, every painted panel + headlights, month-12 health check, 2 days in studio.
- GT Signature — 12,900, most chosen: GT LIFETIME Warranty (film and labour, as long as you own the car), 3 free no-fault panel replacements (any damage, any cause), Diamond Pro premium TPU film, door jambs + boot loading strip included, edges wrapped out of sight, free wash + inspection at 6 and 12 months then yearly for life, 3 days in studio.
- GT Concours — 18,900 full vehicle: everything in Signature plus Diamond Pro X film (the PCU flagship, 15-year manufacturer registration), 6 free no-fault panel replacements, concours preparation, ceramic over film and all uncovered surfaces, free full ceramic refresh at every inspection visit, photo/video protection dossier, collection & delivery, 5 days in studio.
- ONE PRICE, EVERY CAR: no SUV, large-SUV or exotic surcharge. A G-Class or a 911 pays the same as a sedan.

## The GT Owner's Warranty (why it's different)

- Covers film AND labour for as long as the original owner keeps the car. A film brand warranties its film; the studio that fitted it warranties the fitting — at Grand Touch you hold both documents.
- The film manufacturer's warranty is registered to the car as standard; the GT warranty sits on top. Two warranties, one car.
- No-fault panel replacements cover ANY damage cause (scrapes, trolleys, minor accidents) — not just defects.
- The lifetime GT warranty (Signature/Concours) transfers ONCE with the vehicle to one subsequent owner (free transfer inspection, applied for within 30 days of sale); defect cover carries, unused panel replacements do not. Essential's 5-year cover does not transfer.
- Free inspections (6 months, 12 months, then yearly) keep cover active; a missed inspection converts cover to the 5-year base term, never a hard void.
- Full terms published word for word; certificate is signed, numbered, and registered at handover.

## Films

Genuine film from a certified roster (STEK, Diamond Pro, Supreme; Gyeon coatings). Grand Touch selects the film per vehicle and program tier; the brand warranties the plastic, Grand Touch warranties the whole job.
